question:
By winning the Europa League in 2026 I became only the second player ever to win every UEFA club competition.
Incredibly, I also became the first Englishman in thirty years to score more than 10 goals in a Serie A season.
I've played with the likes of Havertz, Dybala & João Félix.

For example: 'That same season, I became the first Englishman since 1996 to top the Serie A scoring charts.' This makes the fact more punchy.
